profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: PhD in Mechanical Engineering specializing in machine learning, AI and computer vision with background in computational fluid dynamics.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Computational fluid dynamics internship
•	Studied incompressible fluid dynamics with heat transfer effects
•	Generated meshes for complex, 3D geometries 
•	Implemented Fast Fluid Dynamics algorithm into OpenFOAM using C++
•	Experimented with the implementation of different interpolation routines

positions.title: PhD Student, Mechanical Engineering
positions.description:
•	Research Area: Computational and Theoretical Fluid Turbulence
•	Research Activities: Worked with a large computer code written in C, C++, and Fortran, Wrote original Matlab codes to analyze fluid flow data
•	Key coursework: Computer Organization and Programming for Scientific Computing, Computational Fluid Dynamics
•	Skills and Experience Acquired: C, C++, Fortran, Matlab, Autotools, MPI Parallelism, GPU Parallelism, CUDA C, High-Performance Computing, Linux, Python
•	Completed M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, August 2012
